snippet.title: Balikaw: An Indie Horror Game
snippet.description:
—————————————————————————————————————
GAME NAME: Balikaw
—————————————————————————————————————
GAME DESCRIPTION 
Forced to leave her home, teenage Pauelette is dropped into the unfamiliar, fading world of her grandmother's remote house in the Philippines. Her Lola Olet is frail and mysteriously absent after sundown, leaving behind only strange, unsettling nightly chores. These aren't simple tasks, some of them are ancient pamahiin, Filipino superstitions that must be performed perfectly. Explore a house that creaks with secrets, solve cryptic riddles, and discover the terrifying truth: you are not alone. Fail a task, and you won't just disappoint your Lola; you won't survive the night. Your only goal: live long enough to go home.
—————————————————————————————————————
